noTypeAliasSuffix.text: Type alias "{{name}}" should end in "Type", "Properties", "Interface", or "Options". Rename to "{{name}}Type", "{{name}}Properties" if it shapes React component props, "{{name}}Options" if it is an options or config bag, or convert it to an interface and use "{{name}}Interface".

noInterfaceSuffix.text: Interface "{{name}}" should end in "Interface", "Properties", or "Options". Rename to "{{name}}Interface", "{{name}}Properties" if it shapes React component props, or "{{name}}Options" if it is an options or config bag.

noConstEnumSuffix.text: Const enum-shaped object "{{name}}" should end in "Kind". Rename to "{{name}}Kind" with a paired "{{name}}KindType" alias, so the runtime value and the type that indexes it are visibly one thing.
